summary: Both halves inspected. The section closes by treating the original choice of W rather than V as a matter of chance and formulating two tests, section comparison and the Lie description under flatness. The long cancelled local/formalization phrase is recoverable and its cancellation x strokes are removed from underlying word spaces. The apostrophe in it’s formal completion is clearly penned. The small upper a-like mark, the margin speck, the cancelled letter in workable, and the old letter in curve remain doubtful. Both Postnikov words have corrected typed o over doubtful e-like older impressions. The author rejects expecting first-order tangent data to recover general affine schemes and uses an elliptic curve minus a point as the contrast.
